issues.description: After the update command starts fetching the current Verus branch, four finite memory-region loops fail the newly enabled execution termination check because they have no decreases clauses.
issues.rationale: The selected commit changes `xtask update` to fetch the requested Verus branch before resetting, making the branch's new execution-termination policy effective in the repository workflow. With official Verus 9e262800af8757047b179a36ca655863bc76d005 (which contains trigger commit fe07347f61c7b024db8bf19d40bb2e1b452c3ffe), the problem snapshot reports `loop must have a decreases clause` at the first loop. Repair commit be0f7880ff3e6dc60fcb461698b459b421f25056 adds decreasing remaining-work measures to all four finite loops, after which the identical fvt1 target reports 22 verified and 0 errors.
issues.source_evidence:
after/fvt1-mem-region-init/src/memory_region.rs
281:     while i < regions.len()
390:     while _i < regions_unusable.len()
409:         while _j < regions_src.len()
435:             while res_vec.len() > 0

Pinned problem run: `loop must have a decreases clause` at line 281. Repair commit be0f7880ff3e6dc60fcb461698b459b421f25056 adds `regions.len() - i`, `regions_unusable.len() - _i`, `regions_src.len() - _j`, and `res_vec.len()` decreases measures; the repaired target reports `22 verified, 0 errors`.
issues.verification: Reproduced with official Verus 9e262800af8757047b179a36ca655863bc76d005, Rust 1.82.0-aarch64-apple-darwin, and Z3 4.12.5: the problem snapshot reports a missing decreases clause at memory_region.rs:281; the repair snapshot reports 22 verified, 0 errors. The related fvt5 repair locations are not labeled because an unrelated pre-existing aster_common attribute incompatibility prevented the fixed run from reaching them.
